responsibility: This header collects the enum and bitmask type definitions that model GCC command-line option states and related policy choices. It defines stable typed representations for debug formats and levels, sanitizer sets, control-flow protection, LTO partitioning/output modes, language-specific option enums, OpenACC/OpenMP policy enums, ranger/threader debug modes, and many other switch domains. Its role is to give option parsing and the rest of the compiler shared typed values instead of raw integers.
